instruction: Check which students have paid tuition (Alice, Bob, Carol) and include their email addresses in the BCC field of the reminder email for documentation purposes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading tuition_payment.xlsx to identify students who have paid (Payment='Yes'), specifically Alice, Bob, and Carol, then adding their email addresses to the BCC field in Thunderbird. Verified with Python: Alice (row 2), Bob (row 3), and Carol (row 4) all have payment status 'Yes'. Evaluator checks for their presence in the Bcc field using accessibility tree selectors. Uses existing check_accessibility_tree metric.
metadata.verification_details: Processed complete Excel file (27 rows): Alice, Bob, and Carol are confirmed as first three paid students with emails alice@someuniversity.edu, bob@someuniversity.edu, carol@someuniversity.edu.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses check_accessibility_tree to verify BCC field contents in Thunderbird compose window
All three required emails (Alice, Bob, Carol) are checked with appropriate CSS selectors targeting the BCC field
Selectors correctly target tool-bar[attr|id=MsgHeadersToolbar] label[name=Bcc] elements with address-pill components
Expected email addresses match the verified payment data from tuition_payment.xlsx (alice@someuniversity.edu, bob@someuniversity.edu, carol@someuniversity.edu)
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) appropriately extracts UI state needed for verification
Metric logic will correctly return 1.0 only if all three emails are found in BCC field
Instruction requirements are fully covered: verifying that students who paid (Alice, Bob, Carol) are in BCC
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider enhancing postconfig to explicitly focus/activate the Thunderbird compose window to ensure accessibility tree captures the correct state
Current postconfig uses only sleep(10) which may be insufficient if the compose window loses focus or is obscured
